SHITET APARTAMENT 1+1 te Rr.Hoxha Tahsin, prane Optika Roma.
Apartamenti ndodhet në një zone te qete dhe mjaft te kerkuar te qytetit.

▪ Pozicionohet ne katin e 2-të banim, apartamenti ka ndriçim natyral gjatë gjithë ditës.
▪Zona ofron facilitete te shumta si, shkolla, kopshte, markete etj.
▪ Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Për më shumë informacion ose për ta vizituar, na kontaktoni!
description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE on Hoxha Tahsin Street, near Optika Roma. The apartment is located in a quiet and highly sought-after area of ​​the city. ▪ Typology: 1 bedroom, living room together with the kitchen, 1 bathroom and a spacious corridor. ▪ Positioned on the 2nd residential floor, the apartment has natural lighting throughout the day. ▪ The area offers many facilities such as schools, kindergartens, markets, etc. ▪ Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or to visit, contact us!
